title: Parental Engagement in Children’s Learning: Insights for remote learning response during COVID-19
abstract: This research brief examines the role parents play in supporting children’s learning when schools are closed and remote instruction becomes necessary. It considers evidence on parental engagement with foundational reading and numeracy, the kinds of support families can provide at home, and the added pressures that school closures place on caregivers. The brief draws lessons for education responses that involve parents while recognizing that families differ in the time, resources, and learning support they can offer.
